summary: Renames the ID-list fields in several admin request bodies (user roles, role menus, role scopes, data-scope rules) to *_ids; internal logic unchanged, but the API contract the admin frontend sends changes.

statements.text: ! The data your server expects changed: it now needs "rule_ids" instead of "rules", "menu_ids" instead of "menus" and 2 more. Anything that sends the old names (your own screens, a mobile app, other services) will be turned away until it changes at the same time.
statements.why: schema/data_scope.py rules->rule_ids, schema/role.py menus->menu_ids and scopes->scope_ids, schema/user.py roles->role_ids; old payloads fail validation (422). Correct and actionable; 'and 2 more' hides that one of them is user role assignment.

statements.text: • The agent changed the sys data scope rules, sys role menus and sys role scopes parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what they do differently.
statements.why: Those three endpoints did change (handler param renamed, api/v1/sys/data_scope.py, role.py), but create/update user (POST/PUT /sys/users) is also affected via schema/user.py role_ids and isn't listed, so the server section reads as if only role/data-scope screens changed.

statements.text: • The agent also changed backend/app/admin/crud/crud_data_scope.py, backend/app/admin/crud/crud_role.py, backend/app/admin/crud/crud_user.py, backend/app/admin/schema/data_scope.py, backend/app/admin/schema/role.py and 4 more files, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Accurate file list (11 files total, 2 api files listed above).

misses.what: Creating/editing users (role assignment, roles -> role_ids) is affected too, not just rules/menus/scopes; the card hides it behind 'and 2 more'.
